content.comment_body: Hello, I am wondering if there is any expansion module available that can read BCD inputs and directly provide the output in decimal or hexadecimal format for further use.
Hello [user_name], From my understanding, there does not appear to be an expansion module that provides this functionality.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asks about the existence of an expansion module capable of reading BCD inputs and automatically converting them to decimal or hexadecimal outputs. The reply indicates that such a feature is not available in the standard expansion modules.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for an off-the-shelf expansion module from [company_name] that can interpret BCD inputs and directly provide decimal or hexadecimal outputs for straightforward integration.
